title: My Cousin's Phone Is ALWAYS At 1% 🔋
description:
In our town, your phone can't run out while you're waiting for someone to call. It just never charges past one percent.

My cousin Ray's phone has said one percent for three years, ever since our fight about Grandpa's old boat. He won't tell anyone who he's waiting on. So I went down to the marina to find out.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: How many times does MY phone show 1% before I notice? Count them.
